<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
<title>End-year function and Christmas party invitation</title>
<script>
  (function () {
    function units() {
      const documentStyle = document.documentElement.style;
      documentStyle.setProperty("--vw", innerWidth / 100 + "px");
      documentStyle.setProperty("--vh", innerHeight / 100 + "px");
    }
    units();
    addEventListener("resize", units);
  })();
</script>
<style>
:root {
  --vw: 1vw;
  --vh: 1vh;
  --deck-safe-left: 6.875vw;
  --deck-safe-right: 6.875vw;
  --deck-safe-top: 5.324vh;
  --deck-safe-bottom: 9.931vh;
  --space-xs: min(.4vw, .71vh);
  --space-sm: min(.7vw, 1.24vh);
  --space-md: min(1.2vw, 2.13vh);
  --space-lg: min(2vw, 3.56vh);
  --green-deep: #0F2E24;
  --green-mid: #17402F;
  --cream: #FBF5E6;
  --ink: #12291F;
  --gold: #E2B54A;
  --cranberry: #B3282D;
  --fill-ink: #5A4A1E;
  --display: "Palatino Linotype", "Book Antiqua", Palatino, Georgia, serif;
  --body: "Segoe UI", Calibri, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif;
}
*, *::before, *::after { box-sizing: border-box; }
button, input, select, textarea { font: inherit; }
body, button, input, select {
  font-size: min(calc(1.3 * var(--vw)), calc(2.31 * var(--vh)));
  line-height: 1.3;
}
html, body, .viewport { width: 100%; height: 100%; margin: 0; overflow: hidden; }
body { font-family: var(--body); color: var(--cream); }
.viewport {
  position: fixed; inset: 0;
  background: #0F2E24;
}
.page {
  width: 100%; min-width: 0; height: 100%; min-height: 0; margin: 0;
  padding: var(--deck-safe-top) var(--deck-safe-right) var(--deck-safe-bottom) var(--deck-safe-left);
  transform-origin: top left; position: relative;
}
.layout {
  position: relative; height: 100%;
  display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 31fr) minmax(0, 69fr);
  gap: var(--space-lg);
}
/* left image card */
.visual {
  display: flex; flex-direction: column; min-width: 0; min-height: 0;
  border-radius: min(1.6vw, 2.8vh); background: var(--green-mid);
  box-shadow: 0 1.4vh 3vh rgba(0,0,0,.45), 0 0 0 .15vw rgba(226,181,74,.55);
}
.visual .photo { flex: 1 1 0; min-height: 0; position: relative; overflow: hidden; border-radius: min(1.6vw, 2.8vh) min(1.6vw, 2.8vh) 0 0; }
.visual img { position: absolute; inset: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; max-width: none; object-fit: cover; }
.visual .cap { flex: none; padding: var(--space-md); }
.cap .year {
  font-family: var(--display); font-size: calc(2.6 * var(--vw)); line-height: 1.2; color: var(--gold); font-weight: 700;
}
.cap p { margin: 0; font-size: calc(1.2 * var(--vw)); line-height: 1.3; color: var(--cream); }
/* right */
.main { display: flex; flex-direction: column; min-width: 0; min-height: 0; gap: var(--space-md); }
.eyebrow {
  margin: 0; font-size: calc(1.05 * var(--vw)); letter-spacing: .18em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--gold); font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.3;
}
h1 {
  margin: 0; font-family: var(--display); font-weight: 700; font-size: calc(3.5 * var(--vw)); line-height: 1.15; padding: 0 .06em .1em 0; color: var(--cream);
}
h1 em { font-style: normal; color: var(--gold); }
.tabs { display: flex; gap: var(--space-sm); flex: none; }
.tab {
  flex: 1 1 0; min-width: 0; cursor: pointer; text-align: center;
  padding: .55em .4em; border-radius: 999px; border: 2px solid rgba(251,245,230,.6);
  background: transparent; color: var(--cream); font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.3;
}
.tab:hover { background: rgba(251,245,230,.16); }
.tab[aria-selected="true"] { background: var(--gold); color: #11271E; border-color: var(--gold); }
.tab:focus-visible, .rsvp-btn:focus-visible { outline: .28vw solid #fff; outline-offset: .2vw; }
.panels {
  display: grid; flex: 1 1 auto; min-height: 0;
  background: var(--cream); color: var(--ink); border-radius: min(1.4vw, 2.5vh);
  box-shadow: 0 1.2vh 2.6vh rgba(0,0,0,.4);
}
.panels > [role="tabpanel"] { grid-area: 1 / 1; visibility: hidden; padding: var(--space-md) var(--space-lg); min-width: 0; min-height: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: var(--space-md); }
.panels > [role="tabpanel"].active { visibility: visible; }
h2 { margin: 0; font-family: var(--display); font-size: calc(1.9 * var(--vw)); line-height: 1.2; color: var(--green-deep); font-weight: 700; padding-bottom: .08em; }
.lead { margin: 0; font-size: calc(1.3 * var(--vw)); line-height: 1.35; color: var(--ink); }
.fields { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0,1fr) minmax(0,1fr); gap: var(--space-sm) var(--space-md); }
.field { padding: var(--space-sm) var(--space-md); border-radius: min(.9vw, 1.6vh); background: #F1E7CC; border: .2vw dashed #9C8236; min-width: 0; }
.field .k { display: block; font-size: calc(1.05 * var(--vw)); letter-spacing: .12em; text-transform: uppercase; font-weight: 700; color: var(--cranberry); line-height: 1.3; }
.field .v { display: block; font-size: calc(1.5 * var(--vw)); font-weight: 600; color: var(--fill-ink); line-height: 1.3; }
.field .v a { color: inherit; text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: .15em; }
.field .v a:focus-visible { outline: .28vw solid var(--green-deep); outline-offset: .2vw; }
.notes-group { display: grid; gap: var(--space-xs); }
.note strong { color: var(--cranberry); font-weight: 700; }
.note { margin: 0; font-size: calc(1.15 * var(--vw)); color: var(--fill-ink); line-height: 1.35; }
.steps { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0,1fr) minmax(0,1fr); gap: var(--space-sm) var(--space-md); }
.steps li { display: flex; gap: var(--space-sm); align-items: flex-start; padding: var(--space-sm); border-radius: min(.9vw, 1.6vh); background: #F1E7CC; min-width: 0; }
.steps .n { flex: none; width: 2em; height: 2em; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--cranberry); color: #fff; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-weight: 700; font-size: calc(1.2 * var(--vw)); line-height: 1.3; }
.steps b { display: block; font-size: calc(1.3 * var(--vw)); line-height: 1.3; color: var(--green-deep); }
.steps span { display: block; font-size: calc(1.1 * var(--vw)); line-height: 1.3; color: var(--ink); }
.swatches { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0,1fr)); gap: var(--space-md); }
.sw { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: var(--space-sm); padding: var(--space-sm) var(--space-md); border-radius: min(.9vw, 1.6vh); background: #F1E7CC; min-width: 0; }
.sw .dot { flex: none; width: 2.6vw; height: 2.6vw; border-radius: 50%; border: .2vw solid var(--ink); }
.sw b { display: block; font-size: calc(1.3 * var(--vw)); line-height: 1.3; color: var(--green-deep); }
.sw span { display: block; font-size: calc(1.1 * var(--vw)); line-height: 1.3; }
.rsvp-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0,1fr)); gap: var(--space-md); }
.rsvp-btn {
  cursor: pointer; padding: .7em .5em; border-radius: min(1vw, 1.8vh); border: .2vw solid var(--green-deep);
  background: transparent; color: var(--green-deep); font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.3; text-align: center;
}
.rsvp-btn:hover { background: #F1E7CC; }
.rsvp-btn[aria-checked="true"] { background: var(--green-deep); color: var(--cream); }
.answer {
  min-height: 4.6em; padding: var(--space-sm) var(--space-md); border-radius: min(.9vw, 1.6vh);
  background: #F1E7CC; font-size: calc(1.25 * var(--vw)); line-height: 1.35; color: var(--ink); display: flex; align-items: center;
}
.answer { flex-wrap: wrap; gap: var(--space-sm) var(--space-md); }
.answer .answer-text { min-width: 0; }
.answer .wa-link { flex: none; padding: .35em .9em; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--gold); color: #11271E; font-weight: 700; text-decoration: none; line-height: 1.3; }
.answer .wa-link:hover { background: #F2CB6B; }
.answer .wa-link:focus-visible { outline: .28vw solid #fff; outline-offset: .2vw; }
.answer.set { background: var(--green-deep); color: var(--cream); }
@media (max-aspect-ratio: 4 / 3) {
  .layout { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  .visual { display: none; }
}
@media (forced-colors: active) {
  .viewport, .panels, .field, .steps li, .sw, .answer, .visual { forced-color-adjust: none; background: Canvas; color: CanvasText; border: 1px solid CanvasText; }
  .tab, .rsvp-btn { forced-color-adjust: none; background: ButtonFace; color: ButtonText; border-color: ButtonText; }
  .tab[aria-selected="true"], .rsvp-btn[aria-checked="true"] { background: Highlight; color: HighlightText; }
  h1, h2, .eyebrow, .lead, .note, .field .k, .field .v, .steps b, .steps span, .sw b, .sw span, .cap .year, .cap p { forced-color-adjust: none; color: CanvasText; }
  .tab:focus-visible, .rsvp-btn:focus-visible { outline-color: Highlight; }
}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<div class="viewport">
<main class="page">
  <div class="layout">
    <figure class="visual" style="margin:0" role="group" aria-label="Festive Christmas scene">
      <div class="photo"><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="A glowing Christmas tree with golden lights, wrapped gifts and festive table decor"></div>
      <figcaption class="cap">
        <div class="year" aria-hidden="true">2026</div>
        <p>A year of teamwork, one festive afternoon together.</p>
      </figcaption>
    </figure>
    <section class="main" role="group" aria-labelledby="title">
      <p class="eyebrow">You are invited</p>
      <h1 id="title">End-Year Function <em>&amp; Christmas Party</em></h1>
      <div class="tabs" role="tablist" aria-label="Invitation sections">
        <button class="tab" role="tab" id="tab-details" aria-controls="panel-details" aria-selected="true" tabindex="0">Details</button>
        <button class="tab" role="tab" id="tab-programme" aria-controls="panel-programme" aria-selected="false" tabindex="-1">Programme</button>
        <button class="tab" role="tab" id="tab-dress" aria-controls="panel-dress" aria-selected="false" tabindex="-1">Dress code</button>
        <button class="tab" role="tab" id="tab-rsvp" aria-controls="panel-rsvp" aria-selected="false" tabindex="-1">RSVP</button>
      </div>
      <div class="panels">
        <div class="active" role="tabpanel" id="panel-details" aria-labelledby="tab-details">
          <h2>Let’s close the year together</h2>
          <p class="lead">Join your colleagues for good food, good company and a little Christmas magic as we celebrate everything we achieved this year.</p>
          <div class="fields">
            <div class="field"><span class="k">Date</span><span class="v">05 December 2026</span></div>
            <div class="field"><span class="k">Time</span><span class="v">11:00 am</span></div>
            <div class="field" style="grid-column:1 / -1"><span class="k">Venue</span><span class="v">East Rest Lodge, Shongoane ~ Marikana, Phahladira, Shongoane, 0555</span></div>
            <div class="field"><span class="k">Contact person</span><span class="v">Bassie ~ 014 004 0336</span></div>
          </div>
          <p class="note">Save the date, we can’t wait to celebrate with you!</p>
        </div>
        <div role="tabpanel" id="panel-programme" aria-labelledby="tab-programme">
          <h2>How the celebration unfolds</h2>
          <ol class="steps">
            <li><span class="n" aria-hidden="true">1</span><div><b>Arrival</b><span>Settle in with a festive welcome drink</span></div></li>
            <li><span class="n" aria-hidden="true">2</span><div><b>Opening with prayer</b><span>A moment of thanks to set the tone</span></div></li>
            <li><span class="n" aria-hidden="true">3</span><div><b>Welcome</b><span>A warm greeting and a look at the day</span></div></li>
            <li><span class="n" aria-hidden="true">4</span><div><b>Year in Review</b><span>Highlights and milestones we shared</span></div></li>
            <li><span class="n" aria-hidden="true">5</span><div><b>Recognition Moments</b><span>Applause for our standout colleagues</span></div></li>
            <li><span class="n" aria-hidden="true">6</span><div><b>Vote of Thanks</b><span>A heartfelt thank you to all</span></div></li>
            <li><span class="n" aria-hidden="true">7</span><div><b>Games, Music &amp; Fun</b><span>Friendly fun, laughter and team spirit</span></div></li>
            <li><span class="n" aria-hidden="true">8</span><div><b>Lunch</b><span>Lunch Lunch Lunch!!!</span></div></li>
          </ol>
          <div class="notes-group"><p class="note">Programme order and times: to be confirmed.</p><p class="note"><strong>Games</strong> to be explained as such on the day. <strong>Bring your singing voice!!!</strong></p></div>
        </div>
        <div role="tabpanel" id="panel-dress" aria-labelledby="tab-dress">
          <h2>What to wear</h2>
          <div class="fields">
            <div class="field"><span class="k">Dress code</span><span class="v">Smart Casual</span></div>
            <div class="field"><span class="k">Theme</span><span class="v">Christmas jingles</span></div>
          </div>
          <p class="lead">Any clothing item that is Christmas themed or the colors below.<br>Blue or Black jeans if worn with T-shirts of the colors below.</p>
          <div class="swatches">
            <div class="sw"><span class="dot" style="background:#9E1B32" aria-hidden="true"></span><div><b>Cranberry red</b><span>Deep and rich</span></div></div>
            <div class="sw"><span class="dot" style="background:#E03131" aria-hidden="true"></span><div><b>Red</b><span>Bright and festive</span></div></div>
            <div class="sw"><span class="dot" style="background:#2E8B3D" aria-hidden="true"></span><div><b>Green</b><span>Fresh and merry</span></div></div>
            <div class="sw"><span class="dot" style="background:#17402F" aria-hidden="true"></span><div><b>Evergreen</b><span>Classic and calm</span></div></div>
            <div class="sw"><span class="dot" style="background:#E2B54A" aria-hidden="true"></span><div><b>Gold</b><span>A sparkle</span></div></div>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div role="tabpanel" id="panel-rsvp" aria-labelledby="tab-rsvp">
          <h2>Will you join us?</h2>
          <div class="rsvp-row" role="radiogroup" aria-label="Your response">
            <button class="rsvp-btn" role="radio" aria-checked="false" data-reply="yes" aria-posinset="1" aria-setsize="3">Yes, count me in</button>
            <button class="rsvp-btn" role="radio" aria-checked="false" data-reply="maybe" aria-posinset="2" aria-setsize="3">Maybe</button>
            <button class="rsvp-btn" role="radio" aria-checked="false" data-reply="no" aria-posinset="3" aria-setsize="3">Can’t make it</button>
          </div>
          <div class="answer" id="answer" role="status" aria-live="polite">Choose a response above, then send it on WhatsApp.</div>
          <div class="fields">
            <div class="field"><span class="k">Reply by</span><span class="v">27 November 2026</span></div>
            <div class="field"><span class="k">Send your reply to</span><span class="v"><a href="https://wa.me/27822196563" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">WhatsApp 082 219 6563</a></span></div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>
  </div>
  <div class="overlay" aria-hidden="true"></div>
</main>
</div>
<script>
const viewport = document.querySelector(".viewport");
const page = document.querySelector(".page");

function contentHeight() {
  const pageTop = page.getBoundingClientRect().top;
  let bottom = pageTop + page.scrollHeight;
  page.querySelectorAll("*").forEach(element => {
    if (element.closest(".overlay")) {
      return;
    }
    bottom = Math.max(bottom, element.getBoundingClientRect().bottom);
  });
  return bottom - pageTop;
}

function fitPage() {
  const viewportWidth = viewport.clientWidth;
  const viewportHeight = viewport.clientHeight;
  page.style.transform = "none";
  page.style.width = `${viewportWidth}px`;
  if (contentHeight() <= viewportHeight) {
    page.style.width = "100%";
    return;
  }
  let low = 0.2;
  let high = 1;
  for (let i = 0; i < 12; i++) {
    const scale = (low + high) / 2;
    page.style.width = `${viewportWidth / scale}px`;
    if (contentHeight() * scale <= viewportHeight) {
      low = scale;
    } else {
      high = scale;
    }
  }
  page.style.width = `${viewportWidth / low}px`;
  page.style.transform = `scale(${low})`;
}

var fitFrame;

function scheduleFit() {
  cancelAnimationFrame(fitFrame);
  fitFrame = requestAnimationFrame(fitPage);
}

new ResizeObserver(scheduleFit).observe(viewport);
window.addEventListener("load", scheduleFit);
window.addEventListener("resize", scheduleFit);
document.fonts?.ready.then(scheduleFit);

/* tabs */
const tabs = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll(".tab"));
function selectTab(tab, focus) {
  tabs.forEach(item => {
    const on = item === tab;
    item.setAttribute("aria-selected", on ? "true" : "false");
    item.tabIndex = on ? 0 : -1;
    document.getElementById(item.getAttribute("aria-controls")).classList.toggle("active", on);
  });
  if (focus) tab.focus();
  scheduleFit();
}
tabs.forEach((tab, index) => {
  tab.addEventListener("click", () => selectTab(tab, false));
  tab.addEventListener("keydown", event => {
    let next = null;
    if (event.key === "ArrowRight") next = tabs[(index + 1) % tabs.length];
    if (event.key === "ArrowLeft") next = tabs[(index - 1 + tabs.length) % tabs.length];
    if (event.key === "Home") next = tabs[0];
    if (event.key === "End") next = tabs[tabs.length - 1];
    if (next) { event.preventDefault(); selectTab(next, true); }
  });
});

/* rsvp */
const WA = "https://wa.me/27822196563";
const replies = {
  yes: { text: "Wonderful, we can’t wait to celebrate with you! Send your reply on WhatsApp:", msg: "Hi, I’m replying to the End-Year Function and Christmas Party invitation: Yes, count me in!" },
  maybe: { text: "Thanks for letting us know. Send your reply on WhatsApp:", msg: "Hi, I’m replying to the End-Year Function and Christmas Party invitation: Maybe, I will confirm soon." },
  no: { text: "We’ll miss you! Send your reply on WhatsApp:", msg: "Hi, I’m replying to the End-Year Function and Christmas Party invitation: Sorry, I can’t make it." }
};
const answer = document.getElementById("answer");
document.querySelectorAll(".rsvp-btn").forEach(button => {
  button.addEventListener("click", () => {
    document.querySelectorAll(".rsvp-btn").forEach(other => other.setAttribute("aria-checked", other === button ? "true" : "false"));
    const reply = replies[button.dataset.reply];
    answer.textContent = "";
    const message = document.createElement("span");
    message.className = "answer-text";
    message.textContent = reply.text;
    const link = document.createElement("a");
    link.className = "wa-link";
    link.href = WA + "?text=" + encodeURIComponent(reply.msg);
    link.target = "_blank";
    link.rel = "noopener noreferrer";
    link.textContent = "Reply on WhatsApp";
    answer.append(message, link);
    answer.classList.add("set");
  });
});
</script>
</body>
</html>
